newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction two unspecified tranches of treasury bills on Wednesday, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
The NBS said one tranche of three-week T-bills, and one with a maturity of 41 weeks would be offered.
In the last auction of three-week T-bills on November 27 average yield was 10.41 percent, up from 7.849 on July 3.

The ministry has not held a 41-week T-bill auction yet this year, but in the last auction of T-bills with nearly similar maturity -- 40-week T-bills issued on November 27 -- average yield was up to 11.249 percent after 10.12 on November 20.
